test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 3 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Solve the following:

240 ÷ 8 × 512 ÷ 4
solution:
**Given:**

240 ÷ 8 × 512 ÷ 4

**Concept used:**

BODMAS

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d0dde522f65134a981f8db6f1ac5aebe5108510a68c758df909f765f209687bd.png] 

The preference will be given on the basis of the letter coming first in the word BODMAS.

**Calculation:**

240 ÷ 8 × 512 ÷ 4

= 30 × 128

= 3840

**Hence, The Required value is 3840.**
